== Summary ==
Prize support for the 2022 Naboo Regionals in Liverpool, UK (23 July 2022), hosted by Team Wales: boxes of coloured foil prize packs, shown in the event announcement.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 Regional Championships]] (Naboo Regionals)
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-04-06

Original attachment name: tempImageDofr01.gif (3779×1528); forum attachment id 16667.
